retired.title: This part of the old dashboard was retired
retired.goInstead: Go to the nearest thing that works

reason.commerce: Orders, subscriptions and payment methods are no longer sold here. Expert review credits are bought when you submit a study.
reason.certificates: Certificate downloads are switched off while the certificate service is under maintenance. Your course progress is kept.
reason.fellowship: The fellowship pages were frozen and their scheduling backend has been replaced. Ask your programme lead for the current arrangement.
reason.rapid-review: The Rapid Review challenges were a separate product embedded in a frame and are not part of Sector.
reason.referrals: Referrals were never used and have been removed.
reason.resources: The resources page was a placeholder that was never filled.
reason.notifications: The in-app notification list has been removed; everything that matters reaches you by email.
reason.registration: Accounts are created for you by your organisation or by a group invitation. Sign in with the details you were sent.
reason.switch-user: Signing in as another user is done from the internal console, not from here.

createScan.storageDegradedTitle: This browser could not save your progress
createScan.storageDegradedBody: Files already uploaded are safe in storage, but this draft will not survive closing or reloading this tab. Keep it open until you submit.
createScan.validationFileTooLarge: "{{name}}" is larger than the {{limit}} study limit on its own, so it cannot be added.
createScan.validationStudyTooLarge: Adding "{{name}}" would take this study past the {{limit}} limit. Remove another file first, or add it to a new study.
createScan.resumingResetBody: {{title}} was reset for re-upload. Add its files again and submit — this attaches them to the same study rather than creating a new one.
createScan.submitIncompleteSubtitle: The study was created, but it does not yet hold every file this draft intended.
createScan.submitIncompleteTitle: {{confirmed}} of {{total}} files attached — the study was not fully submitted
createScan.submitIncompleteBody: The draft and every uploaded file are still here — nothing was thrown away. Try again to resume this same study, or open it to see exactly what landed.
createScan.draftExpiredBody: A draft older than seven days was removed, along with the files it was still holding in this browser. If it had already created a study, that study is still in My Scans.
createScan.expertReviewBlurb: Optional. A GUSI expert reviews the study in addition to any group reviewers. One credit per review.
createScan.creditsLoadFailedTitle: Credit balances could not be loaded
createScan.creditsLoadFailedBody: You can submit the study without an expert review and request one later from the scan.
createScan.noCreditsBody: Neither your balance nor any of your groups has a credit left. The study will be submitted to your groups as usual — expert review can be requested later once credits are topped up.
createScan.creditWillBeSpent: One credit from {{label}} will be spent on submit
createScan.creditSpentOnSubmit: The credit is only spent once the study is submitted. If the request fails you will be told, and the study is saved either way.

scanDetail.resetUploadDialogBody: This puts the study back to Pending and clears its file count. You will be taken to Create Scan Study with this same study open — add the files again and submit to finish it. Nothing already reviewed or answered on this study is affected.
scanDetail.resetUploadError: The scan could not be reset.
scanDetail.requestExpertReviewDialogBody: A GUSI expert reviews “{{title}}” in addition to any group reviewers, for one credit.
scanDetail.requestExpertReviewAlready: An expert review has already been requested for this study. Requesting again would spend a second credit for the same review, so this is disabled.
scanDetail.requestExpertReviewError: The request did not go through.
scanDetail.completionTagError: The scan's completeness could not be changed. Nothing was saved — try again.
